names.name: Tokyo Radiator Mfg. Co., Ltd.
names.business: Makes heat exchangers — radiators, intercoolers, EGR and oil coolers, cooling modules — plus fuel/SCR tanks and body components, mainly for trucks and construction/industrial machinery, from Japan, China and the rest of Asia.
names.cheapness_case: Net cash of JPY 8.5B with zero debt against a JPY 14.5B market cap puts 59% of the price in cash and capitalises the operating business at 2.5x EBIT, while current assets net of ALL liabilities cover 96% of the market cap. It yields 5.06% on a dividend just raised 65 to 77 (payout 30% to 41%), trades at 0.60-0.74x book, and management has put an explicit PBR 1.0x commitment in writing.
names.court_question: Customer concentration versus a written capital-return commitment. Isuzu is 56% of FY3/26 revenue and also a 6.49% holder, so one customer's build schedule sets the P&L — that is the whole risk, and it is not diversifiable at this size. Against it sits the most concrete catalyst in the batch: the TRS Vision-2030 plan of 2026-05-14 targets FY2030 revenue of JPY 50B at a 9% operating margin, ROE of at least 9% and an explicit PBR 1.0x, with a first-ever cash-allocation framework splitting JPY 15B of operating cash flow into JPY 5B growth, JPY 5B base and JPY 5B shareholder returns — and over JPY 40B of the JPY 50B revenue target is already booked as orders. The court has to size the Isuzu tail and test whether the plan is a commitment or a brochure.
names.priority_rationale: The cheapest enterprise in the batch on the most conservative reading, and the only name here with a written PBR 1.0x commitment, an executed treasury cancellation, a raised payout target and a shareholder proposing at the AGM two years running. The catalyst is named and dated rather than assumed.

names.name: Cleanup Corporation
names.business: Japan's system-kitchen specialist — CENTRO and STEDIA kitchen lines plus bathroom and vanity products for homes, stores and commercial buildings.
names.cheapness_case: It trades at 0.53-0.57x book on BOTH equity bases — the only name in the ten whose sub-book status survives the strict test — with JPY 11.9B of net cash against a JPY 32.1B market cap and current assets net of all liabilities covering 74% of the price. At 9.4x trailing earnings, 5.1x EBIT and a 3.6% yield, it is Prime-listed, has a TSE capital-policy disclosure updated 2025-11-20, and actually executed a buyback WITH cancellation in February 2026 rather than merely filing an intention.
names.court_question: Whether the 2.9% operating margin is a floor and whether the register permits anything. FY3/27 guidance calls for revenue up 5.6% and recurring profit up 20.1%, which would answer the margin question — but it is guidance, and on JPY 134.5B of revenue a high-single-digit sales decline still takes operating profit to roughly zero. Against that, roughly 46% of the shares sit with the Inoue founder vehicle at 23.6% plus supplier, dealer and employee associations, so no external party can force anything; the return has to come from management choosing it, which so far they have.
names.priority_rationale: The most defensible sub-book name in the batch — the discount does not evaporate when you use the honest denominator — with Prime-segment reform pressure and the best liquidity-to-size fit for a real position.

names.name: AIDA ENGINEERING, LTD.
names.business: Builds metal-forming press machines — servo, mid-size and large presses — plus automated processing lines, industrial robots, conveyors and dies, selling into Japan, China, the rest of Asia, the Americas and Europe.
names.cheapness_case: JPY 34.3B of net cash covers 53% of the JPY 64.7B market cap and current assets net of all liabilities cover 77%, so a global press-machine franchise turning JPY 78.6B of revenue is available at 5.3x EBIT and 0.75-0.90x book. Alone in this batch it has a proven capital-return record rather than a stated one: buybacks executed WITH cancellation in Jul-2025 and again Mar-2026, and a fresh authorisation on 2026-07-10 for up to 3.30m shares (about 5.5% of the count) plus cancellation. It is also the only line here that trades $1.6M a day.
names.court_question: Two, and the first one is new. On 2026-07-17 the company disclosed unauthorised access to its systems AND postponed its Q1 FY3/27 results announcement indefinitely — as of 2026-08-03 no replacement date has been published, and the stock sits only 12% off its 52-week high, so the market has not marked the event at all. The court cannot underwrite an unknown-scope breach, so the first job is to establish scope, cost and whether the postponement is administrative or substantive. The second question is the original one: whether the 7.2% operating margin is a cycle trough, given press-machine capex is tied to automotive body-line investment that an EV transition disrupts, and a 4.9% return on equity arithmetically justifies a sub-book multiple unless earnings are depressed.
names.priority_rationale: The best capital allocator and the only genuinely scalable line in the batch, now carrying an unpriced continuity event — a Prime-listed company postponed its results after a breach and the tape did not react. That divergence between disclosure and price is exactly what a court is for.

names.cheapness_case: A debt-free IT services business earning a 9.8% return on equity is capitalised at 3.4x EBIT, because JPY 19.7B of net cash — 52% of the JPY 37.6B market cap — sits inside the price. names.name: NITTAN Corporation
names.business: Manufactures engine valves for cars, motorcycles, trucks and buses, plus valves for marine, generator and general-purpose engines sold to engine makers.
names.cheapness_case: At 0.45-0.56x book and 6.3x trailing earnings with a 3.4x EBIT multiple and a 4.1% yield on a newly formalised payout floor of 30%, it screens as the cheapest book-and-earnings combination in the batch, 39% below its 52-week high. Eaton Corporation holds 17.18% as a declared affiliated shareholder, and on 2026-07-21 the US subsidiary won its first-ever engine-valve order from Volkswagen Group, which is what moved the stock 8.1%.
names.court_question: Whether the share count and the end market both hold. A third-party allotment of warrants plus a convertible bond was issued 2025-11-28 and paid in 2025-12-15 — until those terms are pulled, the enterprise value, the net-cash figure and every per-share multiple quoted here are provisional, and the company has also been disposing treasury into restricted-stock compensation rather than buying back. On top of that, FY3/27 guidance is for recurring profit to fall 14% and net income 19% on 8.4% revenue growth, and cash of JPY 11.6B is almost exactly offset by JPY 11.3B of debt so there is no balance-sheet cushion. The underlying question — does an engine-valve maker have a terminal value — is then layered on all of it.
names.priority_rationale: Statistically the cheapest name in the batch and now with two genuine positives (a strategic 17% holder in Eaton and a first VW award), but a live convertible-plus-warrant overhang means the per-share arithmetic is not yet trustworthy. Courted with the cap structure as a gating item, not as a buy candidate.

names.business: Makes thermistors and sensors — temperature, infrared, wind, pressure — plus surge absorbers and current-regulating diodes, sold in Japan and internationally.
names.cheapness_case: It earns an 11-13% return on equity at 0.80-0.96x book and 2.9x EBIT, with JPY 8.8B of net cash covering 46% of the JPY 19.2B market cap, while trading 3% above its 52-week low. names.court_question: Whether the treasury block is a return or a moat, and whether earnings have stopped falling. None of the repurchased stock has been cancelled, and the Ishizuka family holds about 38.9% — family plus treasury is roughly 54.5% of the register, which makes the 15.61% block look like a permanent control device rather than a shareholder return, and there is no external party who can force a cancellation. systematic_observations.finding: The shelf's P/B is computed on NET ASSETS (純資産) over ISSUED shares — both the loosest available bases
systematic_observations.detail: The screen divides by the EDINET 'NetAssets' tag (which includes minority interests and valuation/translation adjustments) and multiplies price by shares ISSUED (which includes treasury stock). The two errors run in opposite directions and do not cancel. On the strict owners'-equity basis (株主資本), six otherwise-attractive shelf names lose their sub-book status entirely: 6809 TOA 0.95->1.13, 1904 Taisei Oncho 1.03->1.15, 6246 Techno Smart 1.02->1.15, 6626 0.80->0.96, 7927 0.74->0.92, 6118 0.75->0.90. Treasury stock is the larger of the two effects for 6626 (15.6% of issued), 7927 (10.3%), 1904 (9.7%), 6118 (8.9%), 7235 (8.4%).
systematic_observations.action: Report P/B as a BAND (net-assets basis / shareholders'-equity basis) and always strike market cap on treasury-adjusted shares. Any 'sub-book, TSE reform applies' claim must be made on the strict basis or it is not a claim.

systematic_observations.finding: The FMV-basis PFIC gate was NOT applied to the JAPAN_BATCH2 (2026-07-29) promotes
systematic_observations.detail: Recomputing the §1297 asset test at today's price on treasury-adjusted market cap: 9845 Parker = 0.507 (already over the 50% line), 5388 Kunimine = 0.498, 5464 Mory = 0.498, 2819 Ebara Foods = 0.494. Four of the five BATCH2 promotes sit at or past the line; only 6804 Hosiden (0.370) has real headroom. The 57-name non-PFIC shortlist that carries the FMV recompute excludes 5388 and 9845 — BATCH2 sourced around it.
systematic_observations.action: Make the FMV-basis recompute a hard pre-court gate, recomputed at LIVE market cap (the denominator is market cap + liabilities, so deep-value entries are anti-selected: the test tightens as the stock falls). Names in 0.45-0.50 carry a fragility flag; in this ten that is 7235 (0.49), 6118 (0.48), 6493 (0.45).

systematic_observations.finding: The 'top-decile is liquidity-disqualified' problem INVERTS below score ~0.80 — and the shelf is truncated exactly where liquidity turns good
systematic_observations.detail: JAPAN_BATCH2 found the 0.89-0.97 score band unexecutable (Kinki Sharyo, best raw metrics, $35k/day). This intake, drawn mostly from score 0.75-0.80, has an IBKR 90-day ADV floor of $292k and a median near $365k, with 6118 AIDA at $1.61M and 3374 at $1.01M — 10-45x the top-decile cohort. The shelf file stops at score 0.744, i.e. the cut lands right at the point where names become tradeable.
systematic_observations.action: Extend the shelf below 0.744 and add an ADV column AT SOURCE (JAPAN_BATCH2 already asked for this and it is still not there). The composite's cheapness ranking is inversely correlated with executability, so score rank alone is the wrong dispatch order.

systematic_observations.finding: Shelf regeneration is DESTRUCTIVE and fails SILENTLY on a Yahoo rate-limit
systematic_observations.detail: Running screen_japan.py rewrites japan_shortlist.json and japan_px_cache.json in place. Yahoo throttled mid-run: the price cache went from 1,203 priced tickers to 403, and the rewritten shortlist replaced 80 of its 120 names — not because anything re-rated (median 2-week price drift across the survivors was 2.4%), but because two-thirds of the universe silently lost its price and dropped out of the ranking. The output looks completely normal: 120 rows, plausible scores, no warning. The good cache was destroyed in the process; both files were restored from git and the repo is clean.
systematic_observations.action: Before this screen is run again it needs (a) a coverage assertion that aborts if priced-ticker count falls materially below the prior cache, (b) write-to-temp-then-promote instead of in-place overwrite, and (c) merge-not-replace on the price cache. Until then, treat any shelf file whose mtime is newer than its stated asof as suspect.

systematic_observations.finding: This cohort has NOT re-rated — the batch-3 staleness kill did not repeat
systematic_observations.detail: Batch 3 lost two of eight names to a re-rate that happened before verification (Yagi was 2.7x the screen's market cap). Across all 47 names re-priced here, the 2026-07-20 to 2026-08-03 move was within +/-8% for every one, and no name in the universe had a split or reverse-split in the six months to 2026-08-03. The post-FYE-split trap did not fire once.
systematic_observations.action: The staleness risk on this shelf is not price — it is the accounting basis (finding 1) and the PFIC denominator (finding 2). Screen-vs-live price checks are cheap and should stay, but they are no longer where the errors live.

systematic_observations.finding: The already-re-rated check has to be YTD/52-week, not screen-date-to-now
systematic_observations.detail: 3374 Naigai Tec is +47.5% YTD and 13% off its 52-week high, and 7927 Muto Seiko +15.2% YTD and 6% off — both look pristine on the two-week screen-vs-live comparison. Conversely 6626 SEMITEC trades 3% above its 52-week low and 1384 Hokuryo has round-tripped a double (+109% then -38%).
systematic_observations.action: Carry a 52-week position and YTD return on every intake row; a name within 10% of its 52-week high is 'discovering', not 'undiscovered', regardless of the multiple.

systematic_observations.finding: The TSE value-up disclosure list is already in the repo and is a free, primary discriminator that the shelf does not use
systematic_observations.detail: desk/data/tse_disclosure_list_2026-07-07.xlsx (JPX official, as of 2026-05-31) resolves the 'TSE reform applies' premise per name. screen_japan.py still carries the tse_plan column as a TODO. Of this ten, eight are on the list and two are not (3374, 7927); 6493's entry is a status-only row with no substantive text and 1384's is 67 characters — nominal compliance, not a capital policy. Market segment also comes free from the same file: 7955/9739/6118 Prime, the rest Standard, which matters because the TSE's PBR pressure is materially weaker on Standard.
systematic_observations.action: Join the disclosure list into screen_japan.py on securities code and populate tse_plan (status, update date, content length, segment, English availability). JAPAN_BATCH2's court_caveat — 'TSE reform at sub-book is prior not evidence' — is answerable from a file already on disk.

systematic_observations.finding: Data-quality gaps to carry into any court on these names
systematic_observations.detail: 6626 SEMITEC has no capex tag in the EDINET store, so its FCF and FCF yield are UNCOMPUTABLE, not zero — the shelf's blank reads as a weak number when it is actually a missing one. 6493 and 3374 map capex to a combined PP&E-plus-intangibles tag, so their FCF is conservative rather than comparable. Prior-year revenue and EBIT are null across the whole store, so no trend, cycle position, or peak-earnings test can be run from the shelf at all — every peak/trough judgement in this batch had to come from the tape or from outside the store.
systematic_observations.action: Backfill prior-period revenue/EBIT into the EDINET store; it is the single change that would let the screen distinguish trough from peak, which is the dominant failure mode in this universe (1384 Hokuryo at 22% ROE on eggs is the live example).

systematic_observations.finding: The qualitative refresh overturned a load-bearing fact on eight of the twelve names it touched — the shelf's numeric layer is necessary but nowhere near sufficient
systematic_observations.detail: Dividend yield was materially wrong on two names in the flattering direction (6626 SEMITEC carried ~5.2% versus 2.81% actual; 7955 Cleanup 4.3% versus 3.63%). Two headline P/E figures are inflated by one-off gains the annual-report tags do not separate (7927 Muto Seiko's 5.2x is a subsidiary-disposal gain, honest figure 7.8x; 1904 Taisei Oncho's 6.0x is a property disposal while operating profit falls). A presumed catalyst was refuted — 7235's Marelli parent-child setup is unwound, Marelli is an ~11% legacy holder — and replaced by a better, real one, the explicit PBR 1.0x commitment in the 2026-05-14 mid-term plan. A capital-return read inverted: 6626's 15.61% treasury sits alongside a 38.9% family stake and has never been cancelled, making it a control device rather than a return. An undisclosed cap-structure overhang surfaced at 6493 NITTAN — warrants plus a convertible issued 2025-11-28 — so every per-share figure on that name is provisional.
